quotes.why: Why Ngok gets a verse of his own: his title is the pattern of the one p1 announces. Found by direct search.

quotes.why: Ngok's salutation formula is to Mañjuśrī where p2's is to Ārya Maitreya — the same genre, a different dedicatee, and the difference is doctrinally placed. Found by direct search.
